objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a sloping back, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length_Proportion: The neck is exceptionally long relative to the body, extending significantly higher than the shoulders.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Appendages: The head features paired, skin-covered bony protrusions (ossicones) rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Back_Profile: The dorsal line slopes downward from the high withers to the lower hindquarters, creating a distinct incline.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Structure: The legs are extremely long and slender in proportion to the torso, supporting a towering overall stance.

objects.taxonomy_description: A manufactured play object characterized by artificial materials and non-biological structural features.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_Composition: Surface exhibits uniform synthetic textures such as molded plastic, plush fabric, or painted finishes rather than organic skin, fur, or scales.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Symmetry: Form displays idealized geometric symmetry or stylized proportions that lack the natural asymmetries and anatomical variations of living organisms.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Joint_and_Articulation: Visible mechanical connections, seams, or fixed rigid poses indicate manufactured assembly rather than biological musculature and skeletal flexibility.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Contextual_Indicators: Presence of manufacturing artifacts such as mold lines, brand logos, tags, or packaging elements confirms artificial origin.

objects.taxonomy_description: Handheld collapsible canopy mounted on a central shaft with radiating ribs. Canopy is fabric (nylon, polyester) stretched over 6-8 metal or fiberglass ribs. When open, diameter is 90-120 cm. Shaft is metal or wood with a curved or straight handle. Collapsible models fold down to 25-35 cm via a telescoping shaft and folding ribs. Canopy colors range from solid black to vibrant patterns. Tip of each rib has a small protective cap. Opening mechanism is manual (push-up) or automatic (button-activated). Ribs converge at a runner that slides along the shaft.
